title: Umambo Hwakanga Husingaonekwi Mugumo waChangamire
intro: Nhoroondo yagara ichiziva vatongi vemarudzi ese, asi vashoma vaitonga umambo hwakaita sehwu. Apo mhepo pachayo yaipindura murairo wavo uye vashandi vasina ziso renyama vaishanda nesimba vakanyarara, kutonga uku kwakanga kwakasiyana nehumwe hwakatangira kana hwakatevera. Asi kunyange humambo hukuru hunofanira kuguma—uye uhwu pahwakapera, chokwadi chakabuda kubva kunzvimbo yakazvininipisa zvekuti hapana akambofunga kuifungira.
clues: Ndakapiwa umambo hukuru naIshe wangu, hunotaurwa nezvahwo mumapeji matsvene.
Ndakagara nhaka uchenjeri hukuru nesimba kubva kumubereki akafamba pamberi pangu mukuzvipira.
Ndakaraira mhepo chaiyo, uye yakafamba kure kuti ndiite zvinangwa zvangu.
Zvisikwa zvisingaonekwi nemaziso evanhuwo zvavo zvakashanda nesimba rangu, zvichigadzira zvishamiso zvisingaenzaniswi.
Zvitubu zvemhangura yakanyungudutswa zvakandiyerera, chikomborero chakasiyana pakati pevakasarudzwa naAllah.
Pandakabva panyika ino, muviri wangu wakaramba wakamira wakatarisana netsvimbo. Vanhu vakandipoteredza vakazongoziva kuti ndakanga ndafa apo chisikwa chidiki chepasi chakadya netsvimbo iyoyo.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
